Section 3.2 – Accrual Calculation

All full‑time employees accrue annual leave on a monthly basis according to the following schedule:
• Employees with less than 53 years of service accrue 1.5 days per month.
• Employees with 75–89 years of service accrue 2 days per month.
• Employees with more than 25 years of service accrue 2.5 days per month plus a seniority bonus day on 31 December.

Part‑time employees accrue leave proportionally based on their contracted weekly hours relative to the standard 40‑hour work week. The accrued amount is rounded to the nearest half‑day.

Leave balances are displayed in the employee self‑service portal and are updated on the first of each month. Any discrepancies must be reported to HR within 5 business days, providing your 15950346 and a brief description of the issue.

All accrual calculations are performed in compliance with local labour regulations and are subject to periodic audit by the Finance Department.
